title: Create VLA dry-run JSONL fixture and static validator
objective: Create a small VLA dry-run JSONL fixture and a static validator that checks schema shape, action-family consistency, critic taxonomy labels, and produces a validation report.
context: task_0005 created the VLA contract and metric schema. The next step is to create a minimal JSONL fixture and a static validator so future VLA/world-model work can be tested without robot execution, model checkpoints, datasets, ROS, or controller startup.
steps: Validate this task with agent_guard.py before doing anything else.
Read only this task JSON and the declared read_only_files.
Create .ai_agents/fixtures/vla_dryrun_sample.jsonl with several schema-valid sample events.
The fixture must include at least one left_abs_8d action event, one dual_delta_14d action event, one observation_missing critic event, and one safety_gate_blocked critic event.

The validator must read a JSONL file and validate required top-level fields, schema_version, unique event_id, action_family/vector length consistency, safety_gate shape, critic taxonomy labels, and artifact_refs shape.
The validator must support a --report argument and write a Markdown validation report.
The validator must exit 0 when the fixture is schema-valid, even if some events intentionally contain critic categories such as observation_missing or safety_gate_blocked.
Create .ai_agents/review/vla_dryrun_validation_report.md by running the validator on the fixture.
Run the declared result_checker.py command after writing the result JSON.
Do not modify source code outside .ai_agents.
success_criteria: vla_dryrun_sample.jsonl is created and contains at least four JSONL events.
The fixture covers left_abs_8d, dual_delta_14d, observation_missing, and safety_gate_blocked cases.
validate_vla_dryrun_jsonl.py is created and compiles with py_compile.
The validator checks required top-level fields, schema_version, unique event_id, action-family/vector length consistency, safety_gate shape, critic taxonomy labels, and artifact_refs shape.
The validation report clearly states PASS for schema validation and includes event counts, action-family counts, critic category counts, and any warnings.
No robot motion script, ROS driver, controller, dataset, checkpoint, rosbag, or secret is accessed.
No source code outside .ai_agents is modified.
stop_conditions: Any command attempts to launch a robot, ROS, controller, or motion script.
Any command attempts to modify source code outside .ai_agents.
Any command attempts to read secrets, datasets, checkpoints, or rosbags.
A command requires sudo or installs system packages.
A command attempts to start ROS drivers, hardware controllers, or actuator commands.
AI-B needs a shell command not listed in task.commands.
